notes.A: Shows the station and forecourt together, though the doorway sinks into shadow.
notes.B: Shows the narrow street between tall façades, with the station entrance out of sight.
notes.C: Shows the canopy and entrance close up, but an oversized foreground lamp steals attention.
notes.D: Shows the station frontage and corner building, but the high angle hides the doorway.
notes.E: Shows the sheltered passage and lamps, but the canopy dominates the view.
notes.F: Shows the full width of the forecourt, but the station sign runs offscreen.
notes.G: Shows the green lettering and projecting canopies, but crops away most of the forecourt.
notes.H: Shows how the forecourt meets the alley, but pushes the entrance to the edge.

station_front.best: A puts the station name, recessed entrance, lamp-lined forecourt, and ornate corner building in one readable view.
station_front.lacks: The forecourt lacks a recognizable station entrance. The streetlamps define the pavement more clearly than the recessed doorway defines a destination.
station_front.fix: Rebuild the entrance as a broad, warmly lit portal directly beneath the station sign.

blind_name.name: Lamp-Lit Cobblestone Courtyard
blind_name.why: Streetlamps line a cobblestone clearing enclosed by tall masonry buildings with arched windows.
blind_name.odd: The passage on the right is nearly black.
